name: @wiser/schema
description: The public models used by Wiser for the integration of ATS job information into public job websites.
author: John A. Fedoruk <johnny@johnfedoruk.com>

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && ./node_modules/.bin/mocha --require ts-node/register --extension ts,tsx src 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'
scripts.coverage: node node_modules/nyc/bin/nyc.js --exclude '**/*.spec.ts' --exclude 'src/config.ts' --extension .ts --reporter lcov --reporter text npm run test
scripts.tsc: npm run clean && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.docs:
patch-package --error-on-fail && node node_modules/typedoc/bin/typedoc --tsconfig tsconfig.build.json --out docs/ src/ && echo '*
!.gitignore' > docs/.gitignore
